name: wedge_block
notes: A flatiron corner block 18 m long, 12 m wide at the back and a rounded prow about 3 m wide, five storeys of pale stone under a slate mansard with dormers and three chimneys, shop arches along both long sides. The prow is the front and faces local -Z; the doors and shop arches open into ground-floor rooms, and it carves nothing.
